name: University of the Basque Country
description: A public multi-campus university serving the Basque Country, with academic and research activity across Biscay, Gipuzkoa and Álava.

name: Kasetsart University
description: A major public research university in Thailand, with a broad academic portfolio and strengths in agriculture, science, engineering, technology and innovation.

name: Paragon International University
description: A private, English-medium university in Phnom Penh offering internationally oriented programmes, including engineering, information technology, business and related fields.

name: University of the Littoral Opal Coast
description: A French public university based along the Opal Coast, with campuses in Dunkirk, Calais, Boulogne-sur-Mer and Saint-Omer.

name: KIIT University
description: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology is a deemed-to-be university in Bhubaneswar, with programmes and research across engineering, computing, science, management and other disciplines.

name: VSB–Technical University of Ostrava
description: A public technical university in Ostrava with a strong focus on engineering, information technology, economics, materials, energy and applied research.

name: University of Ha'il
description: A public university in Ha'il, Saudi Arabia, offering academic programmes and research across science, engineering, health, humanities and other fields.

name: Xi’an University of Finance and Economics
description: A university in Xi’an specialising in economics and management, with related programmes in statistics, information technology, law and other disciplines.

name: Washington State University
description: The Prosser location is Washington State University’s Irrigated Agriculture Research and Extension Center (IAREC), supporting research and extension in agriculture and related sciences.

name: SASTRA Deemed University
description: A deemed-to-be university at Tirumalaisamudram near Thanjavur, with programmes and research in engineering, science, humanities, management, law and other areas.

name: Lebanese University
description: Lebanon’s public national university, with faculties, institutes and branches distributed across the country.

name: Université Polytechnique Hauts-de-France
description: A public university in the Hauts-de-France region, with its principal Mont Houy campus in the Valenciennes area and additional campuses across the region.

name: University of California, Davis
description: A public research university in California, recognised for research and education spanning agriculture, biological and environmental sciences, engineering, medicine and more.

name: University of L’Aquila
description: A public university in central Italy with academic and research activity across engineering, information technology, sciences, medicine, humanities and economics.

name: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology
description: A public university in Shanghai with strengths in engineering, materials science, computer science, management, health-related technologies and applied research.

name: University of Thi Qar
description: A public university in Nasiriyah, Iraq, with colleges and research activity across engineering, science, education, medicine, humanities and other disciplines.

name: Madan Bhandari University of Science and Technology
description: A research-oriented university initiative in Nepal, established to advance science, technology, innovation and higher education.

name: University of Eastern Finland
description: A multidisciplinary public university with campuses in Joensuu and Kuopio, and research and education across sciences, health, environment, business and social sciences.

name: University of Science and Technology of Southern Philippines
description: A public university system in Northern Mindanao, with its main campus in Cagayan de Oro and a focus on science, technology, engineering and related fields.

name: Zitácuaro Institute of Technology
description: A public technological higher-education institution in Zitácuaro, Michoacán, affiliated with Mexico’s Tecnológico Nacional de México system.

name: Mongolian University of Science and Technology
description: A major public technical university in Ulaanbaatar, with schools and research activity in engineering, information and communication technology, applied sciences, management and related fields.
